title: Peanut Butter, Tahini & Oat Cookies
description: Oat cookies with peanut butter, tahini, honey and pumpkin seeds. Choose almond or chickpea flour and a dark chocolate, raisin or date mix-in.

options.label: almond flour
options.note: Richer and softer; no added milk.

options.label: chickpea flour
options.note: Use 40 g chickpea flour plus 10 g milk. The flour thickens the dough and makes it stickier.

options.label: dark chocolate
options.note: 30 g dark chocolate (chips or chopped), the latest default batch.

options.label: raisins
options.note: 45 g raisins in place of the dark chocolate.

options.label: chopped dates
options.note: 40 g pitted, chopped dates in place of the dark chocolate.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 175°C (350°F) and line a baking tray with parchment paper.
Mix peanut butter, tahini, honey, sugar, egg and vanilla until smooth. For the chickpea flour version, add the 10 g milk here too.
Stir the baking soda and salt thoroughly into the wet mixture so they disperse before the dough thickens.
Fold in the {mix-in} and pumpkin seeds with the wet mixture, before the oats go in. This makes them easier to distribute evenly.
Fold in the rolled oats and {flour} last, just until combined. The dough thickens and clumps quickly, so avoid overmixing.
Scoop dough onto the lined tray, leave space between cookies, and flatten slightly. The number of cookies depends on scoop size.
Bake at 175°C (350°F) for about 9–11 minutes; check earlier if making smaller cookies. Make sure the chickpea flour version cooks through.
Leave the cookies on the tray for about 5 minutes before moving them.

notes: Default (latest) version: 40 g honey, 9 g sugar, 40 g almond flour, 30 g dark chocolate, 10 g pumpkin seeds, and no milk.
Chickpea flour replaces 40 g almond flour; add 10 g milk with the wet ingredients.
Raisin option uses 45 g raisins; date option uses 40 g chopped, pitted dates. Both replace the 30 g chocolate while the rest of this recipe stays unchanged.
Stir baking soda, salt, pumpkin seeds and the selected mix-in into the wet ingredients before adding oats and flour, which make the dough clumpy.
Nutrition is estimated from standard ingredient data and an approximate baked weight (around 332 g for the default batch). Actual values depend on brands and water loss in baking.
Uses peanut butter, not almond butter. Cookie count depends on scoop size.
